arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'bottle.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('bottle')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import io
from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8\r\n\r\nabc\r\n--edge--\r\n'
parts=list(_MultipartParser(io.BytesIO(raw),'edge').parse())
p=parts[0];print('upload_metadata',p.name,p.filename,p.content_type,p.charset)
assert (p.name,p.filename,p.content_type,p.charset)==('upload','a.txt','text/plain','utf8')
p.close()
